The only throttle (redis setnx, 60s) lives in TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?, which runs after the job is already enqueued and dequeued. So heavy traffic on a fresh embed_url does flood the Sidekiq queue with jobs that no-op on the redis check. adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil, it unconditionally calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` for every request. There is no dedupe/throttle at enqueue time, so repeated traffic for a fresh `embed_url` can enqueue many `RetrieveTopic` jobs. Although `TopicRetriever#retrieve` has a Redis throttle (`retrieved_recently?`), that throttle runs inside the job after it has already been queued, so the Sidekiq queue can still be flooded with mostly no-op jobs.
